scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:viewer && npm run build:skill && npm run build:weekly-review-skill
scripts.build:skill: mkdir -p dist skill/garmin-bridge && cp garmin-bridge/garmin_lib.py garmin-bridge/sync_activities.py garmin-bridge/requirements.txt skill/garmin-bridge/ && cd skill && zip -r ../dist/coach-skill.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' && cd .. && rm -rf skill/garmin-bridge && echo 'Skill packaged to dist/coach-skill.zip'
scripts.build:weekly-review-skill: mkdir -p dist weekly-review-skill/garmin-bridge && cp garmin-bridge/garmin_lib.py garmin-bridge/sync_activities.py garmin-bridge/sync_wellness.py garmin-bridge/wellness_schema.sql garmin-bridge/requirements.txt weekly-review-skill/garmin-bridge/ && cd weekly-review-skill && zip -r ../dist/weekly-review-skill.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' && cd .. && rm -rf weekly-review-skill/garmin-bridge && echo 'Skill packaged to dist/weekly-review-skill.zip'
